name: mca_log_source_channels
channels: API tracing / stack tracing via ETW or telemetry-based EDR
Abnormal sign-in from scripting tools (PowerShell, AADInternals)
Amsi/Script content + API verdicts during in-memory staging
Behavioral rule for registry enumeration under credential-related paths
Browser or plugin/application logs showing script errors, plugin enumerations, or unusual extension load events
CLSID activation events where ProcessName=mmc.exe and CLSID not in allowed baseline
CodeIntegrity/WDAC events indicating unsigned/invalid DLL loads
CommandLine=copy-item or robocopy from UNC path
Creation or modification of __EventFilter, __FilterToConsumerBinding, or CommandLineEventConsumer
Enumerate Winlogon subkeys for unknown or unsigned binaries
Excessive lookups for domains with suspicious WHOIS or short TTL values
Execution of 'Get-WmiObject Win32_Product' or similar PowerShell cmdlets
First-time egress to non-approved update hosts right after install/update
High-frequency or suspicious sequence of QueryPerformanceCounter/GetTickCount API calls from a non-standard process lineage
Inbound HTTP POST with suspicious payload size or user-agent
Inbound connections to 445, 3389, 5985-5986 with high error/connection-reset rate, followed by new outbound sessions from the same host to internal assets within short interval.
Outbound resolution to hidden service domains (e.g., `.onion`)
Process lineage and API usage enrichment (GetSystemTime, GetTimeZoneInformation, NtQuerySystemTime)
Send/Receive: Emails with suspicious sender domains, spoofed headers, or anomalous attachment types
Send/Receive: Inbound emails containing embedded or shortened URLs
Send/Receive: Inbound emails with attachments from suspicious or spoofed senders
SendOnBehalf/SendAs: Emails sent where the sending identity mismatches account ownership
Service stopped or RecoveryDisabled set via REAgentC
Set-ADUser or Set-ADAuthenticationPolicy with MFA attributes disabled
Suspicious URL patterns, uncommon TLDs, short-lived domains, URL shorteners; HTTP method GET/POST
Suspicious file execution on removable media path
Task registration/execution shortly after a time discovery event
Token issuance events showing anomalous claims or issuers
Unexpected DLL or component loaded at Office startup
Unsigned or invalid image for newly installed/updated binaries
VPN, Citrix, or remote access gateway logs showing external IP addresses
Windows Backup Catalog deletion or catalog corruption
api_call: UpdateProcThreadAttribute (PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS) and CreateProcess* with EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT / StartupInfoEx
http.request: HTTP requests and responses for specific script resources, unexpected content-types (application/octet-stream for script URLs), suspicious referrers, or obfuscated javascript resources
modification to Winlogon registry keys such as Shell, Notify, or Userinit
new rule allowing inbound or outbound connections for remote desktop software
process_start: EventHeader.ProcessId true parent vs reported PPID mismatch
query: High-volume LDAP traffic with filters targeting groupPolicyContainer attributes
rpc_call: srvsvc.NetShareEnum / NetShareEnumAll from non-admin or unusual processes
token_analysis: API calls such as DuplicateTokenEx or ImpersonateLoggedOnUser
